title: Canva launches Canva Craft AI image generation model
excerpt: Canva has introduced Canva Craft, a new in-house AI image generation model that plans designs before creating them.
body_html:
Canva has expanded its artificial intelligence offerings by launching an in-house image generation model named Canva Craft. This new tool enters the market to compete directly with similar offerings from technology companies such as OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google.

According to the company, Canva Craft features a distinct two-stage architecture. This system is designed to plan out a design before actually generating the final image. The planning phase is intended to provide users with greater consistency, control, and precision over the visual output.
